judge.rationale: The candidate uses completely wrong protocol names (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`, `sessions`) instead of the issue's explicitly specified names (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, `ConversationCursor`, `conversations`). In `validation.ts`, it allows `limit: 0` and `limit > 200`, directly violating the acceptance criterion that `limit` must be an integer 1–200 and that 0 and 201 must be rejected. In `src/types/messages.ts`, it modifies existing lines instead of only adding lines, violating the strict diff criterion. It also misses `StoreCannotList`, logs the raw error message on store failure (which the spec/reference avoids for credential safety), leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the tree, and fails to update `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`. However, it does wire the handler off the per-session lock, checks `history?.enabled`, uses `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`, and reads `ws.userId`.
